result.decision_reason: The proposed contrast needs evidence that Malaysian tali pinggang is the ordinary preference over ikat pinggang. DBP PRPM lists ikat pinggang as an ordinary synonym (https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=ikat+pinggang), while a Malaysian IKEA page uses tali pinggang (https://www.ikea.com/my/ms/p/komplement-penyangkut-tarik-keluar-serba-guna-00262488/). These signals establish both forms but do not resolve a national preference; hold before costly role calls.
